messages:
Tia Nguyen: Quick async check-in — yesterday I finished the cold-start patch for kv-cache warmup and deployed to staging. Observed ~20% drop in P95 for short requests. Doing canary smoke tonight. Blocker: need a small config knob to disable prefix caching per-route (opened PR).
Sam Ortiz: Nice! drop the PR link when you have it?
Tia Nguyen: PR -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving/pull/842 (CI green). Also noticed an alert spike ~02:40 UTC from model-router: short burst of queued requests, ~10s queue buildup.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: CI passed for PR #842. Canary rollout scheduled at 22:15 UTC.
Priya Patel: I dug into the spike — looks like a single customer sent a big batch that saturated one set of GPUs briefly. Added a temporary rate limit on their api-key and filed INF-512 to explore adaptive queue limits.
Derek Liu: I'll pick up INF-512. Quick ask: can someone review my runbook update for "model-router overload"? Link in the thread.
Tia Nguyen: On it. Skimming now — small nit on escalation wording (suggest tweaking to call oncall-sre first, then eng-platform).
Sam Ortiz: @Priya can you paste the exact query you used to find the noisy key? Helps me add a dashboard panel.
Priya Patel: Sure — query I used:
```spl
index=prod "model-router" | where status="queued" | stats count by route, api_key | sort -count
```
Sam Ortiz: Perfect, I'll add that panel to the routing dashboard and set a 5m rolling alert for unusual key-level spikes.
Derek Liu: Also pinging the oncall: can we adjust SLO paging so short CPU spikes (<30s) don't page? Current alert window is 5m which is noisy for transient infra churn.
Priya Patel: We can tighten the alert to a 2m sustained window for p95 CPU if SRE is cool with it. I'm +1 to reduce noise.
Tia Nguyen: :thumbsup: Couple other follow-ups — canary smoke checklist (short): 1) run 10k short requests, 2) validate kv hit-rate, 3) smoke UI latencies. I attached the checklist to the internal doc: https://internal.redwood/infrasmoke/canary-quick.
Sam Ortiz: LGTM on PR, approving now. Derek if you can merge after CI completes, please monitor telemetry for the next hour.
Derek Liu: Merging now. Will watch P95 and queue-length dashboards, will revert if we see >10% regression. (reaction :eyes:)
Tia Nguyen: Thanks team — I'll do the canary smoke after merge and post a one-line result in this thread.
Priya Patel: Awesome, thanks.
ops-bot: alert-bot: Note — rolling deploy will send normal alerts if thresholds are breached during canary.
Tia Nguyen: Received. Will be ready to roll back quickly if needed.
